theorem cutoff_jet_bound {U S : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hSU : S ⊆ U)
    {q : E → ℝ} (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ q U)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < q x) (B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ k x, x ∈ S →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k q x‖ ≤ B k * q x ^ (1 - (k : ℝ))) (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → ∀ x ∈ S,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun y => SmoothCutoffs.scaledCutoff a (q y)) x‖ ≤
        C * q x ^ (-(m : ℝ))
